notes.title: New Language Update - Now supporting Russian, Ukranian and Hebrew!
notes.content:
Today we’re proud to announce new localisation updates including Russian, Ukranian and Hebrew languages! 

We couldn’t have added this without the staggering support from all the FMV fans out there, so a big thank you to you all. 

To celebrate the new addition, we’re discounting The Shapeshifting Detective from today with 20% off! for a limited time on Steam.

We have more languages on the way so stay tuned. Is the game translated in your language? Do you have requests for specific languages to be added? Leave your comments below! 

If you're a member of the community and would like to get involved with game localisation then get in touch.

notes.title: An Intoxicating Murder Mystery FMV Game
notes.content:
FMV fans... we're back! 

Wales Interactive are delighted to announce [b]The Shapeshifting Detective[/b] — a supernatural-noir murder mystery FMV game from D'Avekki Studios, the creators of The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker!

In The Shapeshifting Detective you play as Sam - a detective with the ability to (you guessed it) shapeshift! 

Dorota Shaw is dead. And the prime suspects are three tarot readers with the uncanny ability to predict murder - or commit it. It’s your job to find out what else they know - but they won’t reveal their dark secrets to just anyone… Luckily, you can be anyone you want to be. Even the next victim.

Featuring more than 1600 full HD video responses, a randomly chosen murderer and guest starring Rupert Booth (Contraditcion), Anarosa De Eizaguirre Butler (Contradiction) and Aislinn De’Ath (The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker). 

[h1]DON'T MISS DISCOUNTED PRE-ORDERS[/h1]
[+] Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898650/]Wishlist[/url] for updates
[+] Subscribe to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/898650/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url]
[+] Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/walesinter]Twitter[/url]

*Discounted pre-order period starting TODAY at 6pm BST / 10am PST

https://store.steampowered.com/app/898650/

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
- 1600+ full HD FMV videos.
- A large multi-location, multi-suspect world to explore.
- Shapeshift into nine other characters, or be yourself.
- Branching storyline and randomly chosen murderer for high replayability.
- In-game radio station featuring short dark fiction plays between visits.
- Any one of three random murderers helps to minimize spoilers.
- Shapeshift and your dialogue options are voiced by the original actors.
- Not all branching is binary. Push someone too far and discover a different reaction.
- Can’t get that vital clue yourself? Shapeshift into the Police Chief!
- Think your options are a trap? Refuse to speak to potentially unlock a hidden path.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/3295d0989ba70f6a47b1f409e0a36bf3710254c4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/d9300f2e6afdd6f55e36537d435e5581e5af4543.jpg[/img][/url]        [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/5ae84983a35c7c293e34c1eb60ac1be1e85172c6.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/98e163591275b4405fd658096110f122935ba34a.jpg[/img][/url]        [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/97efadbdec19fc78ef969df21cc96e6ed83bbe41.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/2b321a34729749ef538381627715892f553a6219.jpg[/img][/url]        [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/2a3a1695790024648a74216c156c094966ef789f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/ba2abe64da30134935367b6a2514eaa03a87e332.jpg[/img][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33662830/08d0c6c85b1a14be926ebb75b11219eeba865b52.jpg[/img]
